Describe the visible lists on six library indexes for search engines

The FAQ, scenario, comparison, state, topic-hub and reference indexes list approved pages but their structured data does not identify those lists. Approving adds ItemList metadata from the same ordered titles and links already visible on each index. No page wording, legal answer, navigation, address, price or publication status changes. The FAQ index contains links rather than answers, so no FAQPage or invented answers will be added.

Pages affected: /faq/, /scenario/, /compare/, /state/, /hubs/, /reference/
